header.title: Tabs
header.description: Splits related content into sections and shows one at a time, without leaving the page. Use it to switch between views of the same object, such as a project's overview, activity and settings. It follows the WAI-ARIA tabs pattern: each tab is a `<button role="tab">` and each panel a `role="tabpanel"`.

overview.label: Overview
overview.content: Project summary, owners, and the latest activity.

activity.label: Activity
activity.content: Recent comments, commits, and status changes.

members.label: Members
members.content: People with access to this workspace.

playground.title: Playground
playground.description: Adjust the props and see the result and the code instantly. Try the keyboard too: with focus on a tab, the arrow keys move the selection.

base.title: Basic usage
base.description: Pass the tabs in `items`. Each item needs an `id` and a `label`, and its `content` shows in the panel when selected. The first enabled tab is selected by default; use `defaultValue` to start on another. An indicator slides to the selected tab.

icons.title: With icons
icons.description: `icon` adds an icon before the text. It is decorative (`aria-hidden`), so the `label` must be enough on its own.

disabled.title: Disabled tab
disabled.description: With `disabled` the tab looks dimmed, can't be selected and the keyboard skips it. To disable all of them, use `isDisabled` on the component.

vertical.title: Vertical
vertical.description: `orientation="vertical"` puts the list on the left and the panel on the right. The indicator follows the tab along the start edge, and the keyboard uses the up and down arrows. Useful for settings with many sections.

manual.title: Manual activation
manual.description: By default (`activation="automatic"`), the arrow keys switch tabs instantly. With `activation="manual"` they only move focus, and the tab is selected with Enter or Space. Use it when showing a panel is expensive, for example if it loads data.

variants.title: Variants
variants.description: `variant` changes the style: `line` (default) underlines the selected tab, `enclosed` shows it as a card inside a container and `pills` highlights it with a rounded background.

sizes.title: Sizes
sizes.description: `size` changes the height and text of the tabs: `sm` (32px), `md` (40px, default) or `lg` (48px).

fullWidth.title: Full width
fullWidth.description: `fullWidth` splits the available width equally between the tabs. It works well with `enclosed` and few tabs, like a segmented control.

controlled.title: Controlled
controlled.description: With `value` and `onChange` the selected tab lives in your state, so you can change it from outside. `onChange` receives the `id` and the selected item.

mobile.title: Small screens
mobile.description: When horizontal tabs don't fit, the list scrolls sideways instead of overflowing the page. The selected tab scrolls into view. This box simulates a phone width.

import.title: Import
import.description: You can import it from the main entry or from its subpath.

inheritance.title: Inheritance
inheritance.body: Accepts the HTML attributes of the root <div> (HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>), except children, onChange and defaultValue, which mean something else here. classNames adds classes to each part: root, list, tab, panel and indicator.

a11y.title: Accessibility
a11y.roles: The list has role="tablist" with aria-orientation, each tab role="tab" and each panel role="tabpanel".
a11y.selected: The selected tab has aria-selected="true"; the others, false.
a11y.relations: Each tab points to its panel with aria-controls, and each panel is named by its tab through aria-labelledby. Ids are generated with useId.
a11y.roving: Only one tab is in the tab order. Tab enters the list and the next Tab moves to the panel.
a11y.keyboard: The left and right arrows (up and down when vertical) cycle through the tabs. Home and End go to the first and last.
a11y.manual: With activation="manual", the arrows only move focus and Enter or Space select the tab.
a11y.disabled: Disabled tabs have disabled and aria-disabled, and the keyboard skips them.
a11y.panel: Unselected panels have hidden. The visible panel has tabIndex=0 so it can be reached with Tab even without focusable content.
a11y.labels: listLabel is the list's aria-label and defaults to English ("Tabs"). Pass it translated. If a tab's label is not text, use ariaLabel.

cssClasses.title: CSS classes
cssClasses.description: Classes you can use to override styles.

rules.root: Root element. Receives `className` and `classNames.root`. Defines the Tabs variables.
rules.size: Applied based on `size`. Sets the height, padding and text of the tabs.
rules.orientation: Applied based on `orientation`. In `vertical` the list and panel sit in a row.
rules.full: Applied with `fullWidth`. Tabs take equal parts.
rules.disabled: Applied with `isDisabled`. Lowers the opacity of the whole component.
rules.list: List with `role="tablist"`. When horizontal it scrolls sideways if it doesn't fit.
rules.track: Inner container of the tabs and the indicator.
rules.indicator: Indicator that slides to the selected tab. Visible with `data-visible="true"`.
rules.label: Tab text.

cssVariables.title: CSS variables
cssVariables.description: They are defined on `.gem-tabs` and none are written inline, so you can change them from your own class (`.gem-tabs.my-class`) or with Tailwind utilities. The dark theme uses other values.

items.--gem-tabs-fg: Text color of the panel and of tabs on hover.
items.--gem-tabs-indicator: Indicator color in `line` and background base in `pills`.
items.--gem-tabs-selected: Text color of the selected tab.
items.--gem-tabs-track: Bottom line in `line` and list border in `enclosed`.

items.--gem-space-2: Gap between the icon and the text.
items.--gem-space-4: Gap between the list and the panel.
items.--gem-radius-sm: Rounded corners of the tabs and the indicator.
items.--gem-radius-md: Rounded corners of the list in `enclosed` and `pills`.
items.--gem-shadow-focus: Focus ring of the tabs and the panel.

types.title: Exported types
types.description: Available from @gem-org/gem-system to type your own wrappers.

props.title: Props
props.description: It also accepts the HTML attributes of the root `<div>`.

items.value: `id` of the selected tab. Controlled mode.
items.defaultValue: `id` of the initially selected tab. Uncontrolled mode.
items.activation: Whether the arrows select the tab instantly (`automatic`) or only move focus (`manual`).
items.fullWidth: Splits the width equally between the tabs.
items.className: Extra classes for the root element.
items.onChange: Called when a tab is selected. Receives the `id` and the item.

items.id: Unique identifier. Used for selection, ids and `onChange`.
items.label: Tab text. Accepts any node.
items.disabled: Shows it dimmed and it can't be selected.
items.ariaLabel: Accessible name when `label` is not text.
